Alice (Acme): Hey team — after we pinned our account to r-infer-v3-quant yesterday, our embeddings API started returning vectors of length 1280 instead of 1536. Downstream indexer now throws shape errors. Can you help?

Mike (support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact request payload and the model name you pinned to? Also which SDK / curl call are you using?

Alice (Acme): Using our legacy client (acme-sdk v0.12.1). Here's the curl we use:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME" -d '{"model":"r-infer-v3-quant","input":["hello world"]}'``` Response snippet:```{"data":[{"embedding":[0.012, -0.44, ...], "length":1280}], "model":"r-infer-v3-quant"}```

Jordan (eng-ml): Thanks — first pass: model r-infer-v3-quant should be 1536. Two hypotheses: 1) A pinned variant fallback to a quantized smaller-width variant; 2) legacy client has a compatibility shim that truncates/pads embeddings.

Riley (eng-platform): We're rolling a canary earlier that touched batching/pack logic. @ops-bot can you confirm if any pinned-variant substitution rules were applied to that account yesterday?

ops-bot: Account acct-ACME had a variant routing override at 2026-02-14T22:03:09Z — route-> r-infer-v3-quant-lite (vec_width=1280) due to capacity fallback policy.

Sandeep (sre): That matches logs I pulled. The routing policy triggered a capacity fallback during the midnight burst and assigned lite variant for a subset of requests. The lite variant is an older quantized build with 1280 output.

Mike (support): Ok — two urgent items: 1) get your indexer tolerant to mixed vector widths (short term), 2) do you want us to force a rollback/pinned mapping so acct-ACME always resolves to full-width variant?

Alice (Acme): We need consistency — please force our pin to the full-width variant. Also, why did the fallback happen if we explicitly pinned the model? We expected pin to prevent substitution.

Jordan (eng-ml): Good question — pin semantics: pin locks model version id, but not variant routing when a pinned model is logically compatible but a lighter variant exists with same version alias. There's an outstanding edge-case where capacity fallback still substitutes under high load when the pin is at alias level rather than model-id-level.

Riley (eng-platform): Action plan: (a) Immediately remap acct-ACME to model-id r-infer-v3-quant@2026-02-10-full (no-lite fallback) — this prevents substitution; (b) follow-up fix to routing policy to honor alias-level pins; (c) add a server-side audit alert when vector width differs from model profile for a customer.

Sandeep (sre): I've applied the immediate remap — I also revoked the temporary fallback rule for acct-ACME. Can you re-run the failing request and paste the new response?

Alice (Acme): Re-ran it. New response shows length 1536. Indexer ingestion succeeded. Thank you.

Mike (support): Glad that's fixed. We'll keep this thread open until platform changes land. Two follow-ups for us: - documentation update on pin semantics for embeddings; - compatibility check in legacy SDKs that may assume vector width from alias.

Jordan (eng-ml): Also adding a short repro checklist for eng: 1) simulate capacity crunch and force fallback to lite variant, 2) call legacy client v0.12.1 and modern client v1.x to verify behavior, 3) ensure server emits a routing decision header: `X-Assigned-Variant: r-infer-v3-quant-lite` so customers can detect substitution.

Alice (Acme): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please CC me on the rollout notes for the routing policy fix.

Mike (support): Will do. Tagging @Jordan, @Riley, @Sandeep to follow through on platform tasks. :thumbsup:
